title: Imperatives in instructions
summary: Give the bare imperative for the exact lemma, without extra particles. Compare -и/-імо/-іть with zero/-мо/-те. Keep the soft sign in сядь and кинь. The prefix ви- keeps its stress; dictionary stress is also retained in підкреслити forms.

ty.pysaty.note: Imperative, second person singular: a request to one person.

my.pysaty.note: Imperative, first person plural: let us do it together.

vy.pysaty.note: Imperative, second person plural: a request to several people, or a polite one.
